scoring_justification: The paper's central results are the odd-even strain trend in lattice thermal conductance (increase for even, decrease for odd) and the transmission peak enhancement near 1490 cm⁻¹ under strain. The verifier scores these trends and structural thresholds directly from the reported Kph and transmission spectra; recomputing the phonon transport from raw DFT force constants is infeasible in the verifier sandbox.

outputs.description: Thermal conductance values that must demonstrate the odd-even strain effect: relative increase >5% for 8C and decrease >5% for 7C.
Phonon transmission that must show a peak near 1490 cm⁻¹ enhanced under strain for the 8C junction.

output_contract.notes: The checker verifies the strain-dependent trend in K_ph (increase for even-numbered CC, decrease for odd-numbered CC) with a minimum relative difference, and confirms that the transmission peak around 1490 cm⁻¹ is enhanced under strain for the 8C junction.

steps.description: Verify that even-numbered CC (8C) Kph increases by at least 5% under strain and odd-numbered CC (7C) decreases by at least 5%.
Verify that max transmission in 1480-1500 cm⁻¹ for 4zGNR-8C-4zGNR_strained exceeds that for unstrained by at least 0.1.
